# Mathéo Delessert — Portfolio

Interactive, physics-driven creative portfolio of Mathéo Delessert. Click a bag, objects fall, click a project to open it. Built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Matter.js, Three.js.

## Projects

- [Frip'O'Point — motion design](https://matheodelessert.ch/)
- [Vroom Vroom — web design](https://matheodelessert.ch/)
- [Between worlds — web design](https://matheodelessert.ch/)
- [Éracom — school project](https://matheodelessert.ch/)
- [Premier jour d'été — photography](https://matheodelessert.ch/)
- [The portfolio — webdesign/dev](https://matheodelessert.ch/git.html)
- [Korg e-LIVE — 3D / web design](https://matheodelessert.ch/)
